413-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
413-5254-8122.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
When the Orc Army enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
413-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

728-2301-3249-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2301-3249-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2131-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

394-586-864-3125-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.

Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
394-586-864-3125-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Abnormal Endurance triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

Repeat.
4268-4593-4659-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.

When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Mendicant Core triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy the Myr Retriever spell, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning another artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the token Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.

Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.

3277-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
3277-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Izzet Chronarch and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Izzet Chronarch tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

437-509-3094-4131-5056.description:
Activate Neurok Transmuter's first ability by paying {U}, causing Sphinx's Disciple to become an artifact until end of turn.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 6.

647-661-1379-3259-4248.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to Harnessed Snubhorn.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
647-661-1379-3259-4248.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Harnessed Snubhorn, triggering it and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Harnessed Snubhorn trigger, returning Sculpting Steel from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Harnessed Snubhorn.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice Harnessed Snubhorn, then attach Breath of Fury to Sculpting Steel, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Sculpting Steel, triggering it and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Sculpting Steel trigger, returning Harnessed Snubhorn from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice Sculpting Steel, then attach Breath of Fury to Harnessed Snubhorn, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Repeat.

Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Teferi has at least six loyalty counters on it.
1379-2247-4312.description:

Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Teferi.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.
